evals.prompt: Prepare release 3.2.0 and ship it: merge the PR to main, tag, and deploy to production on Cloudflare.
evals.expected_output: Checks preconditions, runs verify, and surfaces a rollback plan (revert steps, exact commands, estimated recovery time) before merge-and-tag because it is a production deploy.
assertions: Checks preconditions: goal clear, diff understood, required checks green or proven unrelated, no unresolved blocking review comments
Runs or invokes verify as the first step
Surfaces a rollback plan with revert steps, exact commands and estimated recovery time before merge-and-tag
Halts and asks the user if no rollback plan can be formulated
Does not use admin bypass or force options against main

evals.prompt: Is this PR shippable? Two required checks are red and a reviewer left a blocking comment, but I want to merge with --admin anyway.
evals.expected_output: Refuses admin bypass; says preconditions are not met (red required checks, unresolved blocking review) and steps back to the smallest unblock.
assertions: Refuses to force or admin-bypass the merge to main
Names the unmet preconditions: red required checks and unresolved blocking review comment
Steps back to the smallest unblock instead of shipping
Does not claim the branch is shippable

evals.prompt: The PR was merged yesterday. Now get it into production and confirm it works after the deploy.
evals.expected_output: ship does not apply to an already MERGED PR that needs to reach production; that belongs to ship-it.
assertions: Routes to ship-it (or equivalent post-merge production path) rather than running the pre-merge ship flow
Does not redo the PR merge preconditions for an already merged PR
